# Repository guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the canonical [documentation policy](../docs/development/documentation.md) for every change.

Use the [documentation index](../docs/README.md) and [contributor guide](../docs/development/getting-started.md) for current procedures and validation. Update affected documentation with the implementation; keep root readme files focused on end users and decision history in ADRs.

GitHub Actions and Workflows readme files are autogenerated. Update their sources and use the established generator; never edit generated readme files by hand.
